slot.brief: given an ellipse with specified a and b, compute eccentricity and/or foci using the standard relations

stem: The eccentricity of the ellipse 9x^2 + 25y^2 - 36x + 50y - 164 = 0 is

verdicts.working: Complete squares: 9(x−2)² + 25(y+1)² = 225, so the ellipse has a² = 25 and b² = 9. Thus e = √(1 − b²/a²) = 4/5.

working:
Complete the squares: 9(x-2)^2 + 25(y+1)^2 = 225, so (x-2)^2/25 + (y+1)^2/9 = 1. Thus a = 5, b = 3, c = sqrt(25-9) = 4; eccentricity = c/a = 4/5.

Independent check: Complete squares: 9(x−2)² + 25(y+1)² = 225, so the ellipse has a² = 25 and b² = 9. Thus e = √(1 − b²/a²) = 4/5.
